name: Stop Falling For It!
author: Sjet, Sungbin, Gyeoeul
bootlegger: The Poppy Grower does not know they are the Poppy Grower. They believe they are a different good character, but they are actually the Poppy Grower. [The Poppy Grower is always in play.]
The Kazali chooses Minion players and characters, but (except for the Marionette) who becomes which character is arbitrary.
The Lord of Typhon learns who the Minions are at the start of the game. (But does not learn their specific characters.)
The Storm Catcher always selects the Poppy Grower.
